original: 今日は遠足なので、うちの子は張り切って出かけた。

en.text: Our child enthusiastically set out today since we're going on a trip.

original: この写真に写ってる子って、知ってる？

en.text: Do you know the boy in this picture?

original: 賢い子だね。

en.text: She's a clever girl.

original: 折角寝かしつけたのに、起こさないでよ。この子、寝かせるの大変なのよ。

en.text: Don't wake him. I've just put him to sleep. It's not easy getting this child to sleep.

original: 白い服を着てる子が僕の婚約者だよ。

en.text: The girl who is dressed in white is my fiancée.

original: 子どもはあっという間に大きくなる。

en.text: The children are growing up really fast.
The kids are growing up really fast.
Children grow up really fast.

original: 子どもの頃、一緒に遊んだね。

en.text: We played together when we were kids.

original: この子、お父さん似ね。

en.text: The boy looks like his father.

original: 新聞は毎朝、地元の配達の子が玄関先まで届けてくれます。

en.text: The newspaper is delivered to my doorstep every morning by the local delivery boy.

original: 私が学校に行ってた時は、左利きの子は右手で書くように強制されてた。

en.text: When I was in school, left-handed kids were forced to write with their right hands.

original: この子に早く会いたいな。

en.text: I can't wait to meet this girl.

original: 子どもの皆さん、毎日牛乳を飲みましょう！

en.text: Kids, drink milk every day!

original: 子どもたちは、車から飛び降り走り出した。

en.text: The kids jumped out of the car and started running.

original: 荀子は人間の本性は悪であると唱えた。

en.text: Xunxi argued that human nature is evil.

original: 桃子は、おはじきを「一つ、二つ、三つ、四つ、五つ、六つ、七つ、八つ、九つ、十」まで数えると黙り込んでしまいました。お母さんが「十一、十二、十三」と続けると嬉しそうに「十四、十五、十六」と数え続けました。

en.text: Momoko counted the marbles: "One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten" and then went silent. When her mother continued with "eleven, twelve, thirteen," she happily picked up with "fourteen, fifteen, sixteen."

original: 田中稔子氏は広島原爆の生存者であり、平和と核軍縮の擁護者として活動しています。

en.text: Toshiko Tanaka is a survivor of the Hiroshima bombing turned advocate for peace and nuclear disarmament.

original: 子どもにより良い教育を受けさせたい。

en.text: We want better education for our children.

original: あの子は賢い子だったよ。

en.text: That child over there is clever, you know.
